datasets.title: Sudan Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Sudan Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sudan_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Sudan to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files for 2021, representing medium-term projections of food insecurity phases across administrative areas.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes triggered by drought and other hazards.
